title: 4.12 Tomorrow and the Week
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Say jetzt and morgen, and talk about die Woche, das Wochenende, den Monat and das Jahr: Eine Woche hat sieben Tage.
grammar_function: Morgen ist + day. Eine Woche hat sieben Tage.
speaking_outcome: Talk about now, tomorrow and the week.
